en: Isaiah 33

p.src: 1  Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.

en: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.
u.src: 1  Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.

p.src: 2  LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

en: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
u.src: 2  LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

p.src: 3  At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

en: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
u.src: 3  At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

p.src: 4  Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

en: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
u.src: 4  Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

p.src: 5  The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

en: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
u.src: 5  The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

p.src: 6  There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.

en: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.
u.src: 6  There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.

p.src: 7  Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

en: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
u.src: 7  Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

p.src: 8  The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

en: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
u.src: 8  The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

p.src: 9  The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

en: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
u.src: 9  The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

p.src: 10  “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

en: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
u.src: 10  “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

p.src: 11  You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

en: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
u.src: 11  You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

p.src: 12  The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

en: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
u.src: 12  The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

p.src: 13  Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

en: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
u.src: 13  Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

p.src: 14  The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

en: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
u.src: 14  The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

p.src: 15  He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

en: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—
u.src: 15  He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

p.src: 16  he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

en: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
u.src: 16  he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

p.src: 17  Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

en: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.
u.src: 17  Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

p.src: 18  Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

en: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
u.src: 18  Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

p.src: 19  You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

en: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
u.src: 19  You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

p.src: 20  Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

en: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
u.src: 20  Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

p.src: 21  But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

en: But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.
u.src: 21  But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

p.src: 22  For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.

en: For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.
u.src: 22  For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.

p.src: 23  Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.

en: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.
u.src: 23  Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.

p.src: 24  The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.

en: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
u.src: 24  The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
